summary: CAMB.AI advertises 33M characters of MARS Text-to-Speech API credits and engineering onboarding for approved startups; the catalog retains an up-to ceiling, not a guaranteed award. Listed criteria are pre-seed through Series A, founded within five years, under $5M raised, a voice/speech/localization product, and no prior CAMB.AI program credits. The six-step application requires contact name/email, company name, startup-partner selection, primary cloud provider and product interests. No-partner/not-listed options are available; phone and CAMB.AI account email are optional. The page says no credit card is required. Confirm grant scope and validity on approval; no global deadline is published.
claim_steps: Complete the six-step application at camb.ai/startup-grants with name/email, company, startup-partner choice, cloud provider and product interests. A no-referral option exists; phone and CAMB account email are optional.
CAMB.AI reviews the submission and replies; approved teams receive up to 33M characters of credits and an onboarding call with engineering.
